answer: Farming becomes a trellis bet on surviving 88 epochs of grading, and every echo settlement recomputes the lotus schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 88 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 16 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 28 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
